rows.grounds: compound of stana and akṣa denoting the nipple; taken as the measured item
demonstrative pronoun referring to the nipple
compound of yava and vyāsa indicating a measure equal to a barley grain's width
compound of dvi and aṅgula indicating a measure of two finger-widths
compound of stana and maṇḍala denoting the circular area of the breast

items.question: What specific measurements define the nipple and the breast-circle in the prescribed iconometry?
premises: The nipple is specified as having the breadth of a barley grain.
The breast-circle is specified as measuring two finger-widths.
items.inference: The verse assigns distinct proportional measures to the nipple and the breast-circle.
uncertainties: Whether stanākṣaṃ refers specifically to the nipple or more generally to the breast's central point is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The nipple is of barley-breadth, and the breast-circle is two fingers in measure.
